Other Repositories (Pinned)

    A C/C++, Objective-C and CUDA language server built on Clang: crash-isolated worker processes, C++20 modules and compilation contexts out of the box, plus a CLI to index, query and refactor whole projects.
  • llvm-project 41.6k 19.9k
    The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
  • kotatsu 37 4
    A C++23 async runtime with reflection-driven serialization, JSON-RPC and LSP, and cross-platform file system and process APIs
  • xclang 42 1
    Cross-compiling with clang: one PGO+ThinLTO toolchain, six targets' sysroots and static runtimes in every archive, programs that depend only on the OS. CMake package, Bazel module, conda.

Hi, I'm ykiko. I like C++, compilers, and building tools that make programming in C++ nicer. In my spare time I work on these at clice-io:

  • clice: a C++ language server for modern C++, focused on high performance and deep code intelligence.
  • xclang: cross-compiling with clang. One PGO+ThinLTO toolchain, six targets' sysroots and static runtimes in every archive, programs that depend only on the OS. Ships as a CMake package, a Bazel module and a conda package.
  • kotatsu: a C++23 async runtime with reflection-driven serialization, JSON-RPC and LSP, and cross-platform file system and process APIs.
  • catter: a tool to capture C++ compilation commands.

I write about C++, compilers and developer tools at ykiko.me.
